t: About DaVaun Sanders • DaVaun Sanders
s: April 2, 2024 - DaVaun Sanders (he/him) is a Black writer of speculative fiction residing in Phoenix, Arizona. He serves as Publisher and Executive Editor for FIYAH Literary Magazine of Black Speculative Fiction, winner of the World Fantasy, British Fantasy and Hugo Awards. His editorial work includes the Breathe FIYAH flash fiction anthology, in collaboration with Tor.com.
